articles.title: What does 'Half a Quilt' tell us about China's new Long March?
articles.titleCn: “半条被子”故事揭示中国新长征的什么内涵？
articles.summary: What does 'Half a Quilt' tell us about China's new Long March?
articles.summaryCn: 文章通过“半条被子”的故事，回顾长征精神中军民鱼水情与人民至上的核心理念，并展现沙洲村及中国在扶贫、乡村振兴和现代化新征程上的具体实践与成就。

When Xi visited the "half a quilt"-themed exhibition hall in September 2020, he called for standing together with the people on the Long March of the new era. Today, that {{8}} is reflected in efforts to improve {{9}}. The village provides monthly {{10}} for residents aged 60 and above and covers half of villagers' basic medical insurance {{11}}. A child-friendly service program also extends across nine neighboring villages.
paragraphs.cn: 他强调，人民的支持是长征胜利的关键，并呼吁在中国现代化征程上取得新成就。从半条被子到美好生活。2020年9月，习近平参观“半条被子”主题陈列馆时，号召在新时代长征路上与人民同舟共济。如今，这一承诺体现在改善民生的努力中。该村为60岁及以上居民提供每月补贴，并承担村民基本医疗保险缴费的一半。一项儿童友好服务项目还覆盖了周边九个村庄。

paragraphs.en: For Xu's {{12}}, the changes are {{13}}. Her grandson, Zhu Xiaohong, once lived in poverty. With support from local CPC authorities, he received {{14}} training and opened a restaurant. "In the past, the Red Army gave us half a quilt; now the Party has brought us happy lives," Zhu has said. Josef Gregory Mahoney, a professor of politics and international relations at East China Normal University, told CGTN that the Long March's {{15}} lesson is that public trust is built by addressing people's needs and sharing both hardships and achievements.
paragraphs.cn: 对徐解秀的后代来说，变化是实实在在的。她的孙子朱小红曾生活贫困。在当地党组织支持下，他接受了烹饪培训并开了一家餐馆。朱小红曾说：“过去红军给了我们半条被子，现在党给我们带来了幸福生活。”华东师范大学政治与国际关系学院教授约瑟夫·格雷戈里·马奥尼告诉CGTN，长征历久弥新的启示是：公众信任建立在回应人民需求、与人民同甘共苦的基础上。

paragraphs.en: Today, poverty {{16}} and rural {{17}} likewise depend on ensuring that people see tangible benefits in their lives. As Xi stressed on Thursday, staying committed to the Party's ideals and purpose and relying closely on the people are essential to creating new achievements. Today, Shazhou is forging its own path on the new Long March, turning its revolutionary {{18}} and {{19}} resources into opportunities for sustainable development and shared {{20}}. The village has restored revolutionary sites and developed red tourism while improving its living environment through river management, {{21}} treatment and waste collection. The wider area has also promoted specialty fruit growing and {{22}} agriculture with tourism, creating new opportunities for local businesses and employment while supporting more sustainable rural development.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，脱贫攻坚和乡村振兴同样依赖于确保人民在生活中看到实实在在的好处。正如习近平周四所强调的，坚守党的理想和宗旨、紧密依靠人民，是创造新成就的关键。今天，沙洲村在新长征路上走出自己的路，将革命遗产和生态资源转化为可持续发展和共同繁荣的机遇。该村修复了革命遗址，发展红色旅游，同时通过河流治理、污水处理和垃圾收集改善人居环境。周边地区还推广特色水果种植，推动农旅融合，为当地企业和就业创造新机会，同时支持更可持续的农村发展。

paragraphs.en: The results are reflected in local figures. Shazhou was removed from the list of {{23}} villages in 2018. By 2025, villagers' annual per capita net income had risen from less than 4,000 yuan (about $634) in 2012 to more than 25,000 yuan, while {{24}} village income had grown from virtually zero to over 1 million yuan. Brazilian expert Rafael Henrique Zerbeto, who joined a program retracing the Long March, noted that putting the people first remains vital to China's development. From {{25}} revolutionary heritage to {{26}} characteristic industries that boost local incomes, he observed how China is channeling the Long March spirit into a driving force for high-quality development.
paragraphs.cn: 成果体现在当地数据中。沙洲村于2018年摘掉贫困村帽子。到2025年，村民年人均纯收入从2012年的不足4000元（约634美元）增长到25000元以上，村集体经济收入从几乎为零增长到超过100万元。参加重走长征路项目的巴西专家拉斐尔·恩里克·泽尔贝托指出，以人为本对中国发展仍然至关重要。他观察到，从保护革命遗产到培育促进当地增收的特色产业，中国正将长征精神转化为高质量发展的动力。

paragraphs.en: A recent CGTN survey of 12,000 respondents across 41 countries found that 63.9% of global respondents closely associate CPC leadership with China's development achievements. Among respondents from Global South countries, the figure reached 71.4%. For Mahoney, the Long March also offers lessons for the Global South: development paths must reflect local conditions, while shared challenges require international cooperation. Its broader message is that lasting progress comes from drawing on a country's own strengths while working with others toward common goals. As Xi said in his anniversary speech, the spirit of the Long March remains "a precious treasure and a powerful driving force inspiring us to {{27}} difficulties and forge ahead courageously."
paragraphs.cn: CGTN近期对41个国家12000名受访者的调查发现，63.9%的全球受访者将中国共产党的领导与中国的发展成就紧密联系在一起。在全球南方国家受访者中，这一比例达到71.4%。马奥尼认为，长征也为全球南方提供了借鉴：发展道路必须符合本地条件，而共同挑战需要国际合作。其更广泛的信息是，持久进步源于发挥本国优势，同时与他人合作实现共同目标。正如习近平在纪念大会讲话中所说，长征精神仍然是“激励我们克服困难、奋勇前进的宝贵财富和强大动力”。

articles.fullText:
In the winter of 1934, three female Red Army soldiers arrived at the home of Xu Jiexiu, a poor villager in Shazhou Village, Hunan Province, during the Long March. Seeing that Xu's family had little to keep them warm, the soldiers cut their only quilt in half and left a portion with her before departing.
The gesture became known as the story of "Half a Quilt," a lasting symbol of the bond between the Communist Party of China (CPC) and the people.
Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday recalled the story at a gathering commemorating the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory.
"Only by remembering history can we create a brighter future," said Xi. He stressed that the people's support was crucial to the victory of the Long March and called for new achievements on China's journey toward modernization.
From half a quilt to better lives
When Xi visited the "half a quilt"-themed exhibition hall in September 2020, he called for standing together with the people on the Long March of the new era.
Today, that commitment is reflected in efforts to improve livelihoods. The village provides monthly subsidies for residents aged 60 and above and covers half of villagers' basic medical insurance contributions. A child-friendly service program also extends across nine neighboring villages.
For Xu's descendants, the changes are tangible. Her grandson, Zhu Xiaohong, once lived in poverty. With support from local CPC authorities, he received culinary training and opened a restaurant.
"In the past, the Red Army gave us half a quilt; now the Party has brought us happy lives," Zhu has said.
Josef Gregory Mahoney, a professor of politics and international relations at East China Normal University, told CGTN that the Long March's enduring lesson is that public trust is built by addressing people's needs and sharing both hardships and achievements. Today, poverty alleviation and rural revitalization likewise depend on ensuring that people see tangible benefits in their lives.
As Xi stressed on Thursday, staying committed to the Party's ideals and purpose and relying closely on the people are essential to creating new achievements.
Today, Shazhou is forging its own path on the new Long March, turning its revolutionary heritage and ecological resources into opportunities for sustainable development and shared prosperity.
The village has restored revolutionary sites and developed red tourism while improving its living environment through river management, sewage treatment and waste collection. The wider area has also promoted specialty fruit growing and integrated agriculture with tourism, creating new opportunities for local businesses and employment while supporting more sustainable rural development.
The results are reflected in local figures. Shazhou was removed from the list of impoverished villages in 2018. By 2025, villagers' annual per capita net income had risen from less than 4,000 yuan (about $634) in 2012 to more than 25,000 yuan, while collective village income had grown from virtually zero to over 1 million yuan.
Brazilian expert Rafael Henrique Zerbeto, who joined a program retracing the Long March, noted that putting the people first remains vital to China's development. From safeguarding revolutionary heritage to fostering characteristic industries that boost local incomes, he observed how China is channeling the Long March spirit into a driving force for high-quality development.
A recent CGTN survey of 12,000 respondents across 41 countries found that 63.9% of global respondents closely associate CPC leadership with China's development achievements. Among respondents from Global South countries, the figure reached 71.4%.
For Mahoney, the Long March also offers lessons for the Global South: development paths must reflect local conditions, while shared challenges require international cooperation. Its broader message is that lasting progress comes from drawing on a country's own strengths while working with others toward common goals.
As Xi said in his anniversary speech, the spirit of the Long March remains "a precious treasure and a powerful driving force inspiring us to overcome difficulties and forge ahead courageously."

articles.summary: 16 killed after M7.0 quake hits China's Xizang, rescue underway
articles.summaryCn: 中国西藏那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震，造成16人死亡、46人受伤，救援工作已全面展开。

paragraphs.en:
Regional fire and rescue brigade conducts {{19}} in Gangqie Township, Baqen County, southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region, October 23, 2026. /Xinhua
Sixteen people were killed and 46 others injured after a {{0}}-7.0 earthquake struck Baqen County of Nagqu City in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region at 10:33 p.m. Thursday (Beijing Time), according to the city's emergency management bureau. Among the injured, 11 are in serious condition and 35 have sustained minor injuries, according to the latest update early Friday morning. The tremor has led to the {{22}} or damage of 339 houses, and 20 {{23}} sheds have been affected.
paragraphs.cn:

据那曲市应急管理局消息，周四晚10时33分（北京时间），中国西南部西藏自治区那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震，造成16人死亡、46人受伤。据周五凌晨的最新消息，伤者中11人伤势严重，35人受轻伤。地震已导致339间房屋倒塌或损坏，20个牲畜棚受到影响。

Members or the regional fire and rescue brigade conduct inspections in Gangqie Township, Baqen County, southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region, October 23, 2026.
paragraphs.cn:
地震发生后，中国地震局启动二级应急响应。包括公安、消防和医疗人员在内的救援力量已抵达灾区，开始密集救援行动。据区域应急指挥中心消息，西藏已启动三级地震灾害应急响应。地震造成的损失正在进一步评估中。更多阅读：实时更新：中国西藏那曲市发生7.0级地震，16人死亡、46人受伤
2026年10月23日，中国西南部西藏自治区巴青县岗切乡，区域消防救援大队成员进行巡查。

paragraphs.en:
/Xinhua
Rescue underway
More than 300 police officers have been {{5}} to the epicenter for relief work, while the regional fire and rescue corps has {{6}} 347 personnel to the affected area. Upon receiving orders late at night, the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) Xizang Military Command and the People's Armed Police Force Xizang Contingent immediately activated their earthquake relief {{7}} plans, {{8}} over 300 personnel and more than 20 {{25}} to travel through the night to the disaster-stricken area. A unit of the PLA Western Theater Command Air Force dispatched an unmanned aerial vehicle to survey the disaster zone and {{9}} real-time footage back to the base. Following the earthquake, public security organs in the Xizang Autonomous Region immediately activated their emergency response plan. More than 300 police officers – including special police, traffic police, and personnel from community-based police service stations in Baqen County, as well as officers from the Maru Township and Gangqie Township police stations, the Nagqu Municipal Public Security Bureau, and the public security organs of the neighboring Biru and Sog counties were {{10}} dispatched to the epicenter to carry out rescue and relief operations.
paragraphs.cn:
/新华社
救援进行中
超过300名警察已被派往震中开展救援工作，同时区域消防救援总队已调派347名人员前往灾区。中国人民解放军西藏军区 and 武警西藏总队接到深夜命令后，立即启动地震救援应急预案，部署300多名人员和20多辆车辆连夜赶往受灾地区。解放军西部战区空军某部派出无人机勘察灾区，并将实时画面传回基地。地震发生后，西藏自治区公安机关立即启动应急响应预案。超过300名警察——包括特警、交警以及巴青县社区警务站人员，还有马如乡和岗切乡派出所、那曲市公安局以及邻近比如县和索县公安机关的警官——被紧急派往震中开展救援和救灾行动。

paragraphs.en: The regional fire and rescue corps has already dispatched 82 vehicles, carrying over 4,200 pieces of equipment and more than 9,400 items of support {{26}}. Meanwhile, the Lhasa and Shannan detachments have been placed on standby to provide {{11}}. To ensure emergency power supply, the State Grid Xizang Electric Power Company Limited has deployed 23 personnel, 6 vehicles, 49 sets of lighting equipment, and 2 low-voltage mobile power generation units to the quake-stricken area. Emergency crews have been working through the night to inspect power {{12}}. Disaster relief supplies, {{13}} across the four levels of central, autonomous region, municipal, and county authorities, began arriving in the affected area in the early hours of Friday.
paragraphs.cn: 区域消防救援总队已派出82辆车辆，携带4200多件装备和9400多件保障物资。同时，拉萨和山南支队已处于待命状态，以提供增援。为确保应急供电，国网西藏电力有限公司已向震区部署23名人员、6辆车辆、49套照明设备和2台低压移动发电机组。应急人员连夜工作，检查电力基础设施。在中央、自治区、市、县四级协调下，救灾物资于周五凌晨开始抵达灾区。

paragraphs.en: These supplies include 1,000 {{14}} housing units, 3,239 tents, 2,821 folding beds, 4,280 quilts, 200 stoves, 100 {{15}}, 2,000 sets of cotton-padded winter clothing, 1,760 military-style overcoats, 4 power {{16}}, 1,000 flashlights, 1,000 outdoor {{17}}, and 694 traditional Tibetan robes. Meanwhile, {{18}} authorities in the region have mobilized personnel to conduct emergency post-earthquake inspections throughout the night, covering roads, bridges, tunnels, {{20}} rocks on slopes, and various other highway structures in the affected areas, in order to maintain an updated {{21}} of the road safety conditions.
paragraphs.cn: 这些物资包括1000套预制房屋、3239顶帐篷、2821张折叠床、4280床被子、200个炉灶、100张床垫、2000套棉衣、1760件军大衣、4台发电机、1000个手电筒、1000个户外头灯和694件传统藏袍。同时，该地区交通部门已动员人员连夜进行震后紧急检查，覆盖灾区道路、桥梁、隧道、边坡危岩及其他公路结构，以保持对道路安全状况的最新评估。

articles.fullText:
Regional fire and rescue brigade conducts inspections in Gangqie Township, Baqen County, southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region, October 23, 2026. /Xinhua
Sixteen people were killed and 46 others injured after a magnitude-7.0 earthquake struck Baqen County of Nagqu City in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region at 10:33 p.m. Thursday (Beijing Time), according to the city's emergency management bureau.
Among the injured, 11 are in serious condition and 35 have sustained minor injuries, according to the latest update early Friday morning.
The tremor has led to the collapse or damage of 339 houses, and 20 livestock sheds have been affected.
The China Earthquake Administration has initiated a Level-II emergency response following the quake. Rescue forces, including police, fire services and medical personnel, have arrived at the affected area and began intensive rescue operations.
Xizang has activated a Level-III earthquake disaster emergency response, according to the regional emergency command center.
The damage caused by the quake is being further evaluated.
Read more: Live updates: 16 killed, 46 injured after M7.0 quake hits Nagqu City in China's Xizang
Members or the regional fire and rescue brigade conduct inspections in Gangqie Township, Baqen County, southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region, October 23, 2026. /Xinhua
Rescue underway
More than 300 police officers have been dispatched to the epicenter for relief work, while the regional fire and rescue corps has mobilized 347 personnel to the affected area.
Upon receiving orders late at night, the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) Xizang Military Command and the People's Armed Police Force Xizang Contingent immediately activated their earthquake relief contingency plans, deploying over 300 personnel and more than 20 vehicles to travel through the night to the disaster-stricken area.
A unit of the PLA Western Theater Command Air Force dispatched an unmanned aerial vehicle to survey the disaster zone and transmit real-time footage back to the base.
Following the earthquake, public security organs in the Xizang Autonomous Region immediately activated their emergency response plan. More than 300 police officers – including special police, traffic police, and personnel from community-based police service stations in Baqen County, as well as officers from the Maru Township and Gangqie Township police stations, the Nagqu Municipal Public Security Bureau, and the public security organs of the neighboring Biru and Sog counties were urgently dispatched to the epicenter to carry out rescue and relief operations.
The regional fire and rescue corps has already dispatched 82 vehicles, carrying over 4,200 pieces of equipment and more than 9,400 items of support supplies. Meanwhile, the Lhasa and Shannan detachments have been placed on standby to provide reinforcements.
To ensure emergency power supply, the State Grid Xizang Electric Power Company Limited has deployed 23 personnel, 6 vehicles, 49 sets of lighting equipment, and 2 low-voltage mobile power generation units to the quake-stricken area. Emergency crews have been working through the night to inspect power infrastructure.
Disaster relief supplies, coordinated across the four levels of central, autonomous region, municipal, and county authorities, began arriving in the affected area in the early hours of Friday. These supplies include 1,000 prefabricated housing units, 3,239 tents, 2,821 folding beds, 4,280 quilts, 200 stoves, 100 mattresses, 2,000 sets of cotton-padded winter clothing, 1,760 military-style overcoats, 4 power generators, 1,000 flashlights, 1,000 outdoor headlamps, and 694 traditional Tibetan robes.
Meanwhile, transportation authorities in the region have mobilized personnel to conduct emergency post-earthquake inspections throughout the night, covering roads, bridges, tunnels, unstable rocks on slopes, and various other highway structures in the affected areas, in order to maintain an updated assessment of the road safety conditions.

articles.fullText:
Artificial intelligence is reshaping the global economy and international power structures. Control over advanced chips, computing power, cloud platforms and foundational models can give countries significant influence over how others access and use AI.
The United States remains a major force in AI innovation. However, its efforts to extend its technological advantages through export controls, integrated technology exports and international partnerships risk turning technological leadership into a system of global dependence.
The United States remains a major force in artificial intelligence (AI) innovation. 
From technological leadership to structural dependence
The US AI Action Plan, released in July 2025, prioritizes maintaining American leadership. An executive order issued the same month launched an initiative to promote exports of US AI technologies, combining hardware, data centers, cloud services, models and applications with government financing and support.
While these integrated packages can help countries adopt AI, they may also tie them to a single technology ecosystem, creating long-term dependence on foreign chips, cloud services and models.
This is a new form of structural inequality. Countries that lack their own computing infrastructure and AI capabilities risk remaining consumers of technology, while the most valuable parts of the AI economy remain concentrated among a small number of countries and companies.
The gap is already substantial. According to the World Bank's Digital Progress and Trends Report 2025, high-income economies accounted for 97 percent of global high-performance computing capacity as of June 2025, while low-income countries held less than 0.1% of global data center capacity.
Why a strategy of dominance may backfire
Efforts to restrict access to advanced technologies may encourage other countries to develop alternative chips, models and supply chains. At the same time, AI innovation depends on international research, open-source communities and global talent networks. Excessive restrictions could weaken these networks and undermine the appeal of US technology.
AI-related risks, from cybersecurity threats to misinformation, also cross national borders. If global governance becomes a tool of geopolitical competition, international trust and cooperation will suffer.
AI governance should instead prioritize equal participation, open and interoperable technologies, risk-based safety standards and a meaningful role for developing countries in setting global rules.
Restricting access to advanced technologies may prompt other countries to develop alternative chips. 
China's role in inclusive AI governance
China has put forward initiatives including the Global AI Governance Initiative in 2023 and the AI Plus International Cooperation Initiative in 2025. At the World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai in July 2026, Chinese President Xi Jinping called for open cooperation, safe AI development, mutual learning among civilizations and improved global governance.
China can contribute by expanding access to open-source models, training programs, affordable applications and shared computing infrastructure. Such cooperation should help partner countries develop local expertise and independent innovation capabilities, while respecting their laws and cultural diversity.
Ultimately, the challenge is to ensure that AI advances benefit more than a handful of technology leaders. A fairer global AI order requires broader access to technology, stronger capacity-building and multilateral rules that give all countries a meaningful stake in shaping the future of AI.
(Shen Yi is a professor at Fudan University's School of International Relations and Public Affairs and Director of its International Governance of Cyberspace Research Center. CGTN reporter Li Shuang also contributed to the article.)

articles.title: South Africa investigates outbreaks linked to poor water quality
articles.titleCn: 南非调查与水质差相关的疾病暴发
articles.summary: South African authorities are investigating two separate outbreaks of gastrointestinal illness, one linked to contaminated municipal water in Tshwane and another affecting students at Rhodes University in the Eastern Cape.
articles.summaryCn: 南非当局正在调查两起胃肠道疾病暴发，一起与茨瓦内受污染的市政供水有关，另一起影响东开普省罗德大学的学生，官方已采取应急措施并承诺恢复安全饮用水。

paragraphs.en: South African authorities are {{0}} two separate {{1}} of gastrointestinal illness, one linked to {{2}} {{3}} water in Tshwane and another affecting students at Rhodes University in the Eastern Cape. In Tshwane, 408 cases have been {{4}} in an outbreak linked to contaminated water supplied by the Bronkhorstspruit Water Treatment Works. Separately, Rhodes University has reported more than 100 cases among students in Makhanda, where the cause of the illnesses remains under investigation. Officials said laboratory tests had found extremely high levels of E. coli and other bacteria in water from the treatment plant and nearby reservoirs.
paragraphs.cn: 南非当局正在调查两起独立的胃肠道疾病暴发，一起与茨瓦内受污染的市政供水有关，另一起影响东开普省罗德大学的学生。在茨瓦内，已记录408例病例，与Bronkhorstspruit水处理厂供应的受污染水有关。另外，罗德大学报告在Makhanda的学生中已有100多例病例，病因仍在调查中。官员表示，实验室检测发现处理厂及附近水库的水中存在极高水平的大肠杆菌和其他细菌。

paragraphs.en: Tests on stool samples from patients also detected norovirus, Campylobacter and Shigella in three of the four {{5}} {{6}}. No cholera bacteria were found in the samples, the statement said. An investigation by the Department of Water and Sanitation found that problems with the city’s chlorine supplier had left water from the treatment plant {{7}} between late September and mid-October. The investigation also found that the municipality had failed to {{8}} residents that the water had not been chlorinated and was {{9}} for human use. The treatment plant draws water from the Bronkhorstspruit River, which the investigation found was affected by {{10}} pollution from {{11}} wastewater treatment works {{12}} and {{13}} sewage pumping stations in Tshwane.
paragraphs.cn: 对患者粪便样本的检测还在四份分析样本中的三份中检测出诺如病毒、弯曲杆菌和志贺氏菌。声明称，样本中未发现霍乱细菌。水和卫生部的调查发现，该市氯供应商的问题导致处理厂的水在9月下旬至10月中旬期间未加氯。调查还发现，市政府未能提醒居民水未加氯且不适合人类使用。该处理厂从Bronkhorstspruit河取水，调查发现该河受到上游功能失调的污水处理厂和茨瓦内故障污水泵站的污水污染影响。

paragraphs.en: Water and Sanitation Minister Pemmy Majodina said the Water Research Commission had been {{14}} to conduct {{15}} water-quality tests and investigate the causes of the {{16}}. Its report is expected by the end of October. President Cyril Ramaphosa {{17}} to affected residents on Tuesday, saying the government had {{18}} to address the crisis. “We are very sorry that it has resulted in the challenge of gastrointestinal illness that has affected a number of people,” he said during a visit to Daveyton, east of Johannesburg. Ramaphosa said the government had established a National Water Crisis Committee to {{19}} the response and {{20}} access to safe drinking water.
paragraphs.cn: 水和卫生部长Pemmy Majodina表示，已任命水资源研究委员会进行独立的水质检测并调查污染原因。其报告预计于10月底完成。总统Cyril Ramaphosa周二向受影响居民道歉，称政府已介入应对危机。“我们非常抱歉，这导致了影响许多人的胃肠道疾病问题，”他在访问约翰内斯堡以东的Daveyton时说。Ramaphosa表示，政府已成立国家水危机委员会以协调应对并恢复安全饮用水供应。

paragraphs.en: At Rhodes University, officials are working with local public health authorities and environmental health {{21}} to determine what caused the illnesses reported among students. The university said medical practitioners had also reported similar cases elsewhere in Makhanda, raising the possibility that the outbreak extended beyond the campus. “While investigations are ongoing, {{22}} measures have been {{23}} on campus, including urgent water-quality testing at residences, the {{24}} of safe drinking water in dining halls, and additional precautions in food preparation,” the university said in a statement. articles.fullText:
South African authorities are investigating two separate outbreaks of gastrointestinal illness, one linked to contaminated municipal water in Tshwane and another affecting students at Rhodes University in the Eastern Cape.
In Tshwane, 408 cases have been recorded in an outbreak linked to contaminated water supplied by the Bronkhorstspruit Water Treatment Works. Separately, Rhodes University has reported more than 100 cases among students in Makhanda, where the cause of the illnesses remains under investigation.
Officials said laboratory tests had found extremely high levels of E. coli and other bacteria in water from the treatment plant and nearby reservoirs.
Tests on stool samples from patients also detected norovirus, Campylobacter and Shigella in three of the four specimens analyzed. No cholera bacteria were found in the samples, the statement said.
An investigation by the Department of Water and Sanitation found that problems with the city’s chlorine supplier had left water from the treatment plant unchlorinated between late September and mid-October.
The investigation also found that the municipality had failed to alert residents that the water had not been chlorinated and was unsafe for human use.
The treatment plant draws water from the Bronkhorstspruit River, which the investigation found was affected by sewage pollution from dysfunctional wastewater treatment works upstream and faulty sewage pumping stations in Tshwane.
Water and Sanitation Minister Pemmy Majodina said the Water Research Commission had been appointed to conduct independent water-quality tests and investigate the causes of the contamination. Its report is expected by the end of October.
President Cyril Ramaphosa apologized to affected residents on Tuesday, saying the government had intervened to address the crisis.
“We are very sorry that it has resulted in the challenge of gastrointestinal illness that has affected a number of people,” he said during a visit to Daveyton, east of Johannesburg.
Ramaphosa said the government had established a National Water Crisis Committee to coordinate the response and restore access to safe drinking water.
At Rhodes University, officials are working with local public health authorities and environmental health practitioners to determine what caused the illnesses reported among students.
The university said medical practitioners had also reported similar cases elsewhere in Makhanda, raising the possibility that the outbreak extended beyond the campus.
“While investigations are ongoing, precautionary measures have been implemented on campus, including urgent water-quality testing at residences, the provision of safe drinking water in dining halls, and additional precautions in food preparation,” the university said in a statement.
It advised staff and students to drink boiled and cooled or bottled water, use safe water to prepare food and brush their teeth, avoid ice and uncooked food washed in untreated water, and wash their hands regularly with soap and water.
In Tshwane, residents supplied by the Bronkhorstspruit system have been told not to use tap water for drinking, cooking, bathing, brushing their teeth or washing food. The water may be used only for flushing toilets until authorities confirm it is safe.
The municipality is distributing drinking water by tanker as technical teams work to address the contamination. Authorities have not announced when tap water will be safe for consumption again.

articles.fullText:
Editor's note: This article was originally written in Chinese by Guo Zengyuan, senior engineer at China's National Climate Center. The article represents the author's opinion, not necessarily CGTN's.
The equatorial Pacific has been warming steadily since September, and Chinese climate monitors say it is on track to become the strongest El Nino on record, likely peaking around November.
Sea-surface temperatures in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific have risen more than 3 degrees Celsius above normal – the first time the index has crossed that level on record at the seasonal scale, according to China's National Climate Center. Forecasters expect the warming to keep fluctuating upward.
That raises an obvious question: A two or three degree swing in the air feels unremarkable, so how can a slightly warmer stretch of ocean disrupt weather around the world? Two things are easy to overlook.
First, El Nino is not a small patch of warm water. It is a temperature anomaly spanning a vast stretch of the equatorial Pacific, and it usually lasts for months. Second, the impact depends not just on how much the water warms, but on where. The tropical ocean is a key source of heat and moisture for the atmosphere. When the water is warmer, more moisture rises into the air, feeding clouds and rain – and that in turn changes where air rises and sinks. El Nino shifts those zones, rearranging winds, pressure and rainfall across enormous regions.
A seesaw across the Pacific
Normally, the equatorial Pacific is warm in the west and cool in the east. Trade winds blow from east to west, piling warm surface water up near Indonesia, while cold water from deeper down wells up in the east to keep it cooler. The warm west feeds rising air and heavy rain; the air then flows east at high altitude and sinks over the cooler east. This east-west loop is known as the Walker circulation.
During El Nino, those trade winds weaken. Warm water spreads toward the central and eastern Pacific, and the upwelling of cold water that usually cools the surface fades. The zones of thunderstorms and heavy rain shift east with it. The changes then reinforce one another: shifting pressure weakens the trade winds further, which pushes still more warm water east. Ocean and atmosphere feed on each other, which is why El Nino is not simply "warmer sea water" but a coupled process.
How a Pacific event reaches distant shores
El Nino forms in the tropical Pacific, yet its fingerprints show up in China, Australia and even North America. Scientists call this a teleconnection: an ocean or atmosphere anomaly in one place alters large-scale circulation, which carries the signal thousands of kilometers away.
Think of it as a line of falling dominoes. Warmer Pacific water changes air movement locally, shifting winds and pressure; those shifts spread outward, changing the moisture and storm tracks that reach other regions. El Nino can alter circulation over the western Pacific and East Asia, affecting rainfall in parts of China, and can bend the North Pacific jet stream, shifting storm activity and bringing unusual rain or temperatures to parts of North America.
Those effects are not uniform. They vary by season and region, and no two El Nino events produce the same outcome everywhere. The signal rarely stays confined to the ocean where it began.
